test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_array_index_simd_numeric (arr Array(UInt32)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_array_index_simd_uint8 (arr Array(UInt8)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_array_index_simd_uint8_short (arr Array(UInt8)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_array_index_simd_thresholds ( u16_80 Array(UInt16), u64_160 Array(UInt64) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_array_index_simd_numeric SELECT materialize(range(4096)::Array(UInt32)) FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO perf_array_index_simd_uint8 SELECT materialize(arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(x % 255), range(4096))) FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO perf_array_index_simd_uint8_short SELECT materialize(range(10)::Array(UInt8)) FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO perf_array_index_simd_thresholds SELECT materialize(range(80)::Array(UInt16)), materialize(range(160)::Array(UInt64)) FROM numbers(20000)
